svg.title: Portable gantry crane — Færanlegur gálgakrani
svg.desc: A horizontal lifting beam spans two splayed support frames with a travelling trolley and centre hook.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-portable-gantry-crane","label_en":"Portable gantry crane","label_is":"Færanlegur gálgakrani","section":"02","category_en":"Lifting, access and site logistics","category_is":"Lyftingar, aðgengi og flutningar á verkstað","batch":1,"tags":["lifting","gantry"],"description":"A horizontal lifting beam spans two splayed support frames with a travelling trolley and centre hook.","design_note":"An overhead span carried on two A-frame legs forms a portable gantry rather than a tower or jib crane.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
